火 is attested as a star name in Shang oracle-bone inscriptions and later in the Classic of Poetry. The 字源 passage tentatively calls it 火星; the CUHK entries identify the referent as 大火/心宿二. The sources do not explain why the star was called 火.

The star-name use is distinct from the literal sense ‘fire’. 字源 tentatively calls the star 火星, while the CUHK entries identify the referent as 大火/心宿二. The evidence does not explain why the star was called 火 or how its name relates to ‘fire’.
